title: LabelRecord
description: One offline ground-truth / negative / ambiguous label of a dataset session (Phase 07, Tasks 07.1/07.3/07.7; reserved in docs/architecture/contracts.md section 6). NON-CAUSAL BY DESIGN: the label is produced from the ReferenceTrack, which uses future frames (docs/architecture/causality-tests.md section 1.1). A LabelRecord is never a stream record (it cannot appear in a RecordStreamHeader), is never an input to any causal component, and is used only as a matching reference and as a training target. The runtime_reference block carries what the causal pipeline saw and is explicitly NOT ground truth.

label_id.description: Deterministic id <session_id>-<hand>-<class>-<counter>, stable across re-runs of the generator on the same inputs (Task 07.3 hash check).

segment_id.description: Recorded segment marker the label falls in (SessionMetadata.segments); null when the label lies outside every marker.

segment_type.description: Copied from the marker. The cue is a PRIOR, never the label: Phase 07 labels come from the observed reference trajectory (rules document section 2).

episode_id.description: Entry episode (one outside-to-inside entry of a zone by a hand). Non-null for every label bound to a zone entry; null for interval labels.

level.description: EVENT: an instant (t_event). INTERVAL: a time range (t_start, t_end).

zone_id.description: Zone the label concerns; null for interval labels that concern no single zone (tracking loss, no-strike motion).

t_event.description: Instant the label refers to on t_mono: the surface crossing for crossing labels, the closest-approach instant for fake-swing / stop-before-impact. Null iff level = INTERVAL.

t_impact_est.description: OFFLINE GROUND-TRUTH IMPACT TIME: sub-frame interpolated crossing of the zone impact surface by the REFERENCE tip trajectory, per the Phase 04 entry test (rules document R1). Non-null only when a valid inward crossing exists (POSITIVE; AMBIGUOUS when the crossing is near threshold). Null for every NEG_* class: a fake swing or a stop-short has no impact. This is the reference for lead time and timing error (README section 10) and is never visible to any causal component.

frames.description: Frame references into the session frames.jsonl. first/last bound the labelled window; before/after bracket t_event (consecutive processed frames of this hand, before <= after).

impact_position.description: Crossing point on the impact surface (REQ-038), from the reference trajectory.

crossing_velocity.description: Reference tip velocity at the crossing (ROI-norm/s).

intensity_proxy_gt.description: PRIMARY GT intensity proxy (REQ-014): component of the reference tip velocity along the zone inward normal at t_impact_est. An intensity PROXY, never a force.

intensity_secondary.description: Alternative proxies stored so Phase 11 can compare them with the primary definition; never substituted for it silently.

approach.description: Quantities the negative rules (R3, R4) threshold on, stored for every event so a decision can be re-checked without re-running the generator. Distances in ROI-normalized units, speeds in ROI-norm/s.

confidence.description: Label confidence from the REFERENCE tracking quality around the event (rules document R7); not a probability that a strike happened.

interpolated.description: True if any reference sample in the window was filled across a gap shorter than the smoother bound.

t_impact_phys.description: Physical impact time from the microphone onset (ADR-0002). Non-null ONLY for a labelled impact inside a PAD segment on its pad_zone_id with a paired acoustic onset (contracts.md section 6 invariant).

residual_s.description: t_impact_phys - t_impact_est (Task 07.6): a measured offset, never a claim that the two are the same instant.

label_rule_id.description: The rule of docs/dataset/labeling-rules-v1.0.md that produced this class.

qc_status.description: Reserved name of contracts.md section 6. PENDING_REVIEW until a reviewer has seen the label.

labeller_id.description: Reserved name of contracts.md section 6. Who or what produced the label: generator:<labels_version> for the machine pass. A reviewer pseudonym lives in review.reviewer_id and never overwrites this field.

reviewer_id.description: Annotator pseudonym (A1, A2, ...). Never a real name.

original.description: The generator values before the first adjustment; an adjusted label always keeps its original (Task 07.5).

second_pass.description: Independent re-review of the stratified agreement subset (Task 07.5), recorded beside the first pass; it never silently overwrites it.

resolution.description: Default resolution of a presence / zone / class disagreement is AMBIGUOUS (rules document R6): the event leaves the metric numerator and denominator and stays in the dataset.

runtime_reference.description: REAL-TIME AVAILABLE SIGNALS carried beside the label for cross-reference and Phase 18 matching diagnostics. NEVER ground truth and never copied into t_impact_est: they come from the causal track, whose noise must not define ground truth (Task 07.2).

causal_t_impact_est.description: What the CAUSAL geometry produced for the same entry, if anything: a runtime STRIKE CANDIDATE time, not the annotated ground truth.

strike_id.description: COMMITTED strike of the recorded session, if the commit policy committed this entry: a decision of the live system, not a label.

causal.description: A LabelRecord is non-causal by construction. The const makes a label unusable as a causal record by inspection.

excluded.description: True iff the label falls inside a quarantined segment or session (Phase 06 exclusion log). An excluded label is kept, counted and never used in any metric.

exclusion_ref.description: exclusion_id of the ExclusionRecord that excluded it; non-null iff excluded.

labels_version.description: Version of the labelling rules plus generator inputs. Versioning rule (Task 07.10): any change to rules, thresholds, tracker or smoother produces a NEW labels_version.

dataset_version.description: ds-none-v0.0 until the labels enter a dataset manifest. ds-v<M>.<m> = participant dataset; ds-v<M>.<m>-pilot = pilot; ds-v0.0-selftest[-<slug>] = SYNTHETIC / DEV CAPTURE self-test only.

source_kind.description: Copied from SessionMetadata.session_kind. Evidence produced from labels is reported per source_kind and the kinds are never combined into one number (integrity I-4).

label_class.description: Label classes of the rules document (Task 07.1). AMBIGUOUS is retained in the dataset and excluded from every metric numerator and denominator; EXCLUDED marks material inside a quarantined segment.

adjustable.description: The fields a reviewer may adjust (Task 07.5): the sub-frame impact time, the event instant, the zone, the class.

provenance.description: Everything needed to reproduce this label from the raw session (Task 07.3). The validator refuses a label set whose provenance does not match the label-set metadata document.

tracker_id.description: Frozen Phase 03 tracker id that produced the CAUSAL track.

v_min.description: Phase 04 minimum inward speed of the entry test in force for this label set.

interpolation.description: Sub-frame crossing estimator used for t_impact_est (ADR-0020).

reference_track_ref.description: Path of tracks_reference.jsonl relative to the label directory. NON-CAUSAL artefact.

causal_track_ref.description: Path of tracks_causal.jsonl relative to the label directory.

labels_hash.description: Hash over rules, thresholds, smoother, tracker, geometry and layout: two label sets with the same labels_hash were generated by identical machinery.
